dogecoin.text: The irony about $DOGE is it will likely go to space before $NXS, a coin built on the hype of a never fulfilled promise to launch cryptocurrency into space.

If you want to gauge a successful UTXO project against an unsuccessful one, compare #Dogecoin to #Nexus.

$NXS marketcap is 0.12% the size of $DOGE.

Why? Because Doge development is simple, more decentralized, has use cases, and it works.
